paragraphs.text: Research in human-vehicle interaction has shown even systems designed to automate driving are far from being error-proof. Recent evidence points to drivers' limited understanding of what these systems can and cannot do as a contributing factor to system misuse. A recent study tackles the issue of over-trusting drivers and the resulting system misuse from a legal viewpoint. It looks at what the manufacturers of self-driving cars should legally do to ensure that drivers understand how to use the vehicles appropriately.

paragraphs.text: One solution suggested in the study involves requiring buyers to sign end-user license agreements (EULAs), similar to the terms and conditions that require agreement when using new software products. But this is far from ideal. The agreement may not provide enough information to the driver, leading to confusion about the nature of the requests for agreement and their implications. Further, most end users don't read EULAs. A 2017 study shows 91 percent of people agree to them without reading. Among young people, 97 percent agree without reviewing the terms.

sentences.text: Driver training for self-driving vehicles can help ensure that drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations.

analysis.translationLiteral: 针对自动驾驶车辆的驾驶员培训，能帮助确保驾驶者充分理解系统的能力与局限。
analysis.translationNatural: 给司机做专门培训，才能真正让他们弄明白这套系统能干什么、边界在哪。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Driver training for self-driving vehicles】 _can help ensure_ {that drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓宾 + 宾语从句（that 引导）

components.note: 名词短语作主语；for 短语说明培训对象
help (to) do 结构，此处 ensure 前省略 to

components.part: that drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations

clauses: 宾语从句「that drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations」：that 引导作 ensure 的宾语；capabilities and limitations 是一对反义并列
本句主干为「主谓宾 + 宾语从句（that 引导）」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: 帮助（help sb do sth / help with）；帮助（不可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：help sb do/to do（不带 doing）/ can't help doing（忍不住）。常见搭配：help sb do sth / help with。
phrases.example: Instincts can help you decide fast. 直觉能帮你快速决定。

phrases.meaning: 确保、保证、使安全（ensure that）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：ensure（确保，及物，ensure that / ensure sth）/ insure（给…投保；美语也作确保）/ assure（向某人保证，assure sb that，须接人）/ make sure（口语）/ ensure 不接 sb that。
phrases.example: Driver training for self-driving vehicles can help ensure that drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations. 给司机做专门培训，才能真正让他们弄明白这套系统能干什么、边界在哪。

phrases.meaning: 理解、明白；得知、获悉；体谅
phrases.usage: 注意区分：understand（理解、明白，及物，通常不用进行时）/ understand doing / understand that / make oneself understood（把意思说明白）/ comprehend（更正式）/ understanding（理解；谅解，名词）。
phrases.example: Driver training for self-driving vehicles can help ensure that drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations. 给司机做专门培训，才能真正让他们弄明白这套系统能干什么、边界在哪。

pitfalls: 注意区分：help sb do/to do（不带 doing）/ can't help doing（忍不住）。
注意区分：ensure（确保，及物，ensure that / ensure sth）/ insure（给…投保；美语也作确保）/ assure（向某人保证，assure sb that，须接人）/ make sure（口语）/ ensure 不接 sb that。
注意区分：understand（理解、明白，及物，通常不用进行时）/ understand doing / understand that / make oneself understood（把意思说明白）/ comprehend（更正式）/ understanding（理解；谅解，名词）。

sentences.text: This needs to occur beyond the vehicle purchase.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这需要在购车之外发生。
analysis.translationNatural: 而且不能只在买车那一刻搞一次，得往后延续。
analysis.structMarkup: 【This】 _needs to occur_ (beyond the vehicle purchase).
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 不定式 + 状语

components.note: 回指上一句的 Driver training
need to do 表必要；occur 意为「发生、进行」
beyond 意为「超出……之外」，点明培训不能止于购车环节

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主谓 + 不定式 + 状语」。

phrases.meaning: 需求（need 的复数）；需要（动词三单）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：needs（需求/三单）/ need（需要）。常见搭配：meet needs / needs to do。
phrases.example: The system meets basic needs. 这个系统满足基本需求。

phrases.meaning: 购买； purchases 购买的东西
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：purchase products。
phrases.example: This needs to occur beyond the vehicle purchase. 而且不能只在买车那一刻搞一次，得往后延续。

beyond the vehicle purchase：beyond 意为「超出……之外」，点明培训不能止于购车环节
analysis.paragraphRole: 给培训加一个时间条件：要覆盖购车之后，排除「交车时讲一遍」的做法。

sentences.text: Recent evidence shows even relying on the information provided by the seller is not going to answer many questions.

analysis.translationLiteral: 近期的证据显示，即便是依赖销售方所提供的信息，也不会回答许多问题。
analysis.translationNatural: 有证据摆着：光听销售介绍，很多疑问照样没答案。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Recent evidence】 _shows_ 【even relying on the information provided by the seller】 _is not going to answer many questions_.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 宾语从句（省略 that，动名词短语作从句主语）

components.note: 与首段 Recent evidence 呼应，用数据支撑末段建议
后接省略 that 的宾语从句

components.part: even relying on the information provided by the seller
components.note: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 is；provided by the seller 是过去分词作后置定语

components.part: is not going to answer many questions
components.note: be going to 表将来／推断，此处意为「解决不了」

clauses: 宾语从句主语「even relying on the information provided by the seller」：动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 is；provided by the seller 是过去分词作后置定语
从句谓语「is not going to answer many questions」：be going to 表将来／推断，此处意为「解决不了」
条件状语从句中，主句表将来时从句用一般现在时。

phrases.meaning: 最近的、近来的
phrases.usage: 注意区分：recent（最近的）/ recently（副词）/ resent（怨恨）。常见搭配：recent study / in recent years。
phrases.example: One recent study found a surprising result. 最近一项研究发现了意外的结果。

phrases.meaning: 证据（不可数）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：evidence（不可数，不加 -s）/ evident（形容词，明显的）。常见搭配：evidence suggests / evidence of/for。
phrases.example: The evidence suggests not. 证据表明并非如此。

phrases.meaning: 依赖、依靠、信赖、指望（rely on/upon）（rely 的现在分词/动名词形式）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：relying（现在分词/动名词）/ rely（原形）。
phrases.example: Recent evidence shows even relying on the information provided by the seller is not going to answer many questions. 有证据摆着：光听销售介绍，很多疑问照样没答案。

pitfalls: if 引导条件从句时，从句不用 will 表将来。
注意区分：recent（最近的）/ recently（副词）/ resent（怨恨）。
注意区分：evidence（不可数，不加 -s）/ evident（形容词，明显的）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 堵死「靠卖家讲解即可」这条退路，把培训方案立得更稳。

sentences.text: All of this considered, the road forward for self-driving cars is not going to be a smooth ride after all.

analysis.translationLiteral: 把这一切都考虑在内，自动驾驶汽车前进的道路终究不会是一段平稳的行程。
analysis.translationNatural: 综上，自动驾驶这条路，说到底不会走得太平顺。
analysis.structMarkup: (All of this considered), 【the road forward for self-driving cars】 is not going to be a smooth ride (after all).
analysis.structureSummary: 独立主格结构作状语 + 主系表

components.note: 独立主格（名词 + 过去分词），意为「把这一切都考虑在内」

components.part: the road forward for self-driving cars
components.note: 用 road 作比喻，呼应全文的「行车」语境

components.part: is not going to be a smooth ride
components.note: a smooth ride 一语双关：既指「平稳的驾驶」，也指「顺利的进程」
意为「终究、说到底」，给全文下结论

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「独立主格结构作状语 + 主系表」。

phrases.meaning: 毕竟、终究
phrases.usage: 可表「别忘了」或「结果与预期相反」。
phrases.example: After all, he's only a child. 毕竟他只是个孩子。

phrases.meaning: consider 的过去分词，认为、考虑
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：be considered to be。
phrases.example: All of this considered, the road forward for self-driving cars is not going to be a smooth ride after all. 综上，自动驾驶这条路，说到底不会走得太平顺。

phrases.meaning: go 的现在分词；（be going to）将要
phrases.usage: 注意区分：be going to（计划/预测）/ will（临时决定或预测）。常见搭配：be going to / what's going on。
phrases.example: Attitudes are going to change. 态度将会改变。

pitfalls: after all 表「毕竟」，above all 表「最重要的是」。
注意区分：be going to（计划/预测）/ will（临时决定或预测）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用一句双关收束全文：法律与安全难题未解，前路仍不平坦。

questions.stem: What do we learn from research in human-vehicle interaction?

options.text: Automatic driving systems are by no means immune to errors.
Driverless vehicles are likely to be misused by some people.
Self-driving car manufacturers are not aware of the legal matters involved.
There is a long way to go before humans can interact with driverless vehicles.

questions.stem: What is the problem with requiring buyers to sign end-user license agreements?

options.text: End users, young and old alike, find the terms complex to interpret.
Most end users sign them without bothering to read the terms.
Many people are often confused by the wording of the terms.
Most end users do not understand the terms after reading them through.

questions.stem: What would drivers do when they suffer from "warning fatigue"?

options.text: Waste no time keeping the car moving.
Rest a while to avoid fatigue driving.
Take no action despite repeated warnings.
Take note of the message though fatigued.

questions.stem: What does the author think of continuing to ask buyers to sign end-user license agreements?

options.text: It will probably not guarantee the safety of drivers in case of accidents.
It likely won't ensure that the automatic driving system functions properly.
It likely won't fully protect automakers against accusations of deliberate cheating.
It will probably not provide manufacturers adequate protection from legal responsibilities.

questions.stem: What should be done to help drivers fully understand system capabilities and limitations?

options.text: Training them to be experts in vehicle automation.
Familiarizing them with the systems through training.
Broadening their knowledge of accident-prevention mechanisms.
Facilitating their access to the information provided by the seller.

accident.sense: 事故、意外遭遇；偶然、巧合（by accident 偶然地；car accident 车祸）
examples: Given these limitations and concerns, even if this mode of obtaining consent is to move forward, it likely won't fully protect automakers from their legal liability should the system malfunction(发生故障) or an accident occur. 把这些短板摆在一起看：就算还让买家签协议，真出了故障或撞了车，车企也别想靠它把法律责任摘干净。

agree.sense: 同意、赞成、意见一致；相符、一致（agree with/to/on）
examples: A 2017 study shows 91 percent of people agree to them without reading. 2017 年有研究给出数字：91% 的人看都不看就点了同意。

examples: One solution suggested in the study involves requiring buyers to sign end-user license agreements (EULAs), similar to the terms and conditions that require agreement when using new software products. 研究给的一个办法是：让购车者签一份「最终用户许可协议」，就跟装新软件时得勾选同意的那堆条款差不多。

more.confusables: agreements / agreement（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）
